title: Positional isomers of Indolyl-benzodiazepines display dissimilar binding and recruitment of BET transcriptional regulators to targeted genomic loci.
authors: Chowdhury, Nilanjana; Nithianantham, Stanley; Dey, Sudip; Mohammed, Rafi; Mohammed, Ashraf; Churion, Kelly; Lang, Walter; Young, Sarah; Philips, Steven J; Das, Sourav; Ray, Bedabrata; Shelat, Anang; Fischer, Marcus; Ansari, Aseem Z; Jaisankar, Parasuraman
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BET溴结构域配体与蛋白结合及招募，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: BET proteins contain two tandem bromodomains (BD1 and BD2) that bind histone acetyl-lysine residues that can be targeted with small molecule inhibitors such as IBET-762, which bears a triazolo benzodiazepine core. Here, we report the consequences of substituting the pendant chlorobenzene moiety of IBET-762. Substitution with larger ring structures diminishes bromodomain binding, and even subtle changes on the phenyl ring significantly impact affinity. Structural analysis, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations of four indolyl-benzodiazepine derivatives indicate that ligand selectivity arises from interaction with His433 in BD2. Their ability to engage BET proteins in cells was tested by incorporating them into heterobifunctional synthetic genome readers and regulators (SynGRs). The relative activity of each SynGR corresponded to the affinity of the tethered BET ligand for the BD2 domain. The development and structure-activity relationship analysis of these BET ligands provides a blueprint for the construction of increasingly selective BET inhibitors and proximity-inducing molecules.
abstract_zh: BET蛋白包含两个串联的溴结构域（BD1和BD2），它们结合组蛋白乙酰赖氨酸残基，这些残基可被小分子抑制剂如IBET-762靶向，该抑制剂含有一个三唑并苯二氮䓬核心。在此，我们报告了取代IBET-762中悬挂的氯苯基部分所带来的后果。用更大的环状结构取代会减弱溴结构域的结合，即使苯环上的细微变化也会显著影响亲和力。对四种吲哚基-苯二氮䓬衍生物的结构分析、分子对接和分子动力学模拟表明，配体选择性源于与BD2中His433的相互作用。通过将这些配体整合到异双功能合成基因组阅读器和调节器（SynGRs）中，测试了它们在细胞内与BET蛋白结合的能力。每个SynGR的相对活性与所连接的BET配体对BD2结构域的亲和力相对应。这些BET配体的开发及构效关系分析为构建更具选择性的BET抑制剂和邻近诱导分子提供了蓝图。
